final: WITH curr_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(feecoin, 'NULL') as currency, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_reb, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate > 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) as avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) as bench_val FROM curr_stats WHERE avg_reb IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT cs.avg_reb, cs.avg_gap, cs.avg_reb - b.bench_val as excess FROM curr_stats cs, benchmark b WHERE cs.avg_reb > b.bench_val) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) as avg_avg_rebate, AVG(avg_gap) as avg_gap_ratio, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM filtered
